discussion.title: Announcement: Version 2.0 Released!
discussion.body:
We're excited to announce the release of version 2.0! 🎉

## What's New
- Complete rewrite in TypeScript
- Improved performance (3x faster)
- New configuration options
- Better error messages
- GraphQL support for discussions

## Breaking Changes
- Configuration file format updated
- Minimum Node.js version is now 20

## Migration Guide
Please see our [migration guide](https://example.com/migrate) for details.

Thank you to all contributors!
